Core Components & Lazy Loading Strategy** **Main Component:** [IconPicker.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/IconPicker.vue#L1-L150) The picker uses **four async-loaded manifests** loaded on mount: - [cdn-icon-manifest-instui.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-icon-manifest-instui.json) — InstUI icons (mixed Lucide + custom sources) - [cdn-icon-manifest-lucide-lab.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-icon-manifest-lucide-lab.json) — Lucide Lab set - [cdn-icon-manifest-simple.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-icon-manifest-simple.json) — Simple Icons brand slugs (~4.7 MB raw, ~1.8 MB gzip per script) - [cdn-plugin-manifest.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-plugin-manifest.json) — Custom components, plugins, logos **Manifest Load Pattern:** Each loads separately with error handling, showing "Loading icon list…" state. Deep-linking (URL hash) allows state restoration once manifests arrive. --- ### **2. Glyph Rendering CSS Mechanism** The icon display uses a **three-layer CSS system**: #### **Layer 1: Icon Tokens** — [icons.css](formats/components/dist/icons.css) Contains 1800+ `--instui-icon-` custom properties, each holding an inline SVG data-URI: ```css :root { --instui-icon-check: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg...%3E'); --instui-icon-chevron-down: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg...%3E'); /* ... 1800+ more ... */ } ``` #### **Layer 2: Glyph Classifiers** — [icon-glyphs.ts](formats/components/src/utilities/icon-glyphs/index.ts#L42-L60) Generated by `iconGlyphsCss()`, creates one class per icon: ```css .-icon-check { --pantoken-glyph: var(--instui-icon-check); } .-icon-chevron-down { --pantoken-glyph: var(--instui-icon-chevron-down); } /* The -render-icon-* deprecated aliases also exist when built with deprecatedAliases: true */ ``` #### **Layer 3: Painter Utility** — [icon.css](formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css#L15-L23) The shared `::before` pseudo-element that renders all glyphs: ```css [class*="-icon-"]::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; vertical-align: -0.125em; background: currentColor; -webkit-mask: var(--pantoken-glyph) center / contain no-repeat; mask: var(--pantoken-glyph) center / contain no-repeat; } ``` **Key technique:** The `mask` property (with `-webkit` prefix for older browsers) uses the SVG data-URI as a mask image. The `background: currentColor` fills it in the element's inherited color, so glyphs inherit text color and scale with font-size. **Concrete Example —** A rendered icon: ```html ``` Results in: 1. `--pantoken-glyph` resolves to `var(--instui-icon-search)` 2. Which is `url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg...search-glyph...%3E')` 3. The `::before` masks that SVG and paints it in `currentColor` --- ### **3. Per-Icon CSS Delivery** — [build-icon-entries.ts](formats/components/scripts/build-icon-entries.ts) For CDN optimization, each icon also ships as a **standalone ~1-line file**: ``` formats/components/generated/icons/.css ``` Example: [arrow-left.css](formats/components/dist/icons/arrow-left.css) would contain: ```css :root{--instui-icon-arrow-left:url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,...')}.-icon-arrow-left{--pantoken-glyph:var(--instui-icon-arrow-left)} ``` This pattern allows: - **Selective loading:** Only load icons you use (via CDN URL builder) - **Combined URLs:** Multiple icons per request via jsDelivr combine syntax - **Fallback to full sheet:** Or load all with `icons.css` (master bundle) --- ### **4. Lazy Rendering & Performance** **Lazy Loading Techniques Used:** 1. **Async Manifest Loading:** Three icon sources load independently with `shallowRef` (Vue 3), avoiding unnecessary re-renders until data arrives 2. **Image Lazy Loading (Simple Icons only):** - [PickerToggleGroupItem.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/PickerToggleGroupItem.vue#L61) uses `loading="lazy"` on `` tags: ```html ``` - Logo images fetched from jsDelivr CDN; native browser lazy-loading defers off-screen images 3. **Scrollable Sections:** - [Icon picker sections](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/IconPicker.vue#L645): ```css .icon-picker__sections { max-height: 28rem; overflow-y: auto; } ``` - Limits vertical scroll; grid layout with `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(9rem, 1fr))` 4. **Search Filtering:** Computed property filters icons synchronously (no pagination needed; filtering is fast enough for 1800+ items) 5. **No Virtual Scrolling:** Uses native CSS scrolling + Vue reactivity; performance is adequate because: - Icons are `::before` pseudo-elements (not real DOM nodes per icon) - Each grid item is a checkbox + span, very lightweight - Manifest loading is the bottleneck, not rendering **What's NOT used:** No `content-visibility`, no `IntersectionObserver`, no virtual list library — the approach prioritizes simplicity over extreme scale. --- ### **6. CSS Bundle Strategy** | File | Purpose | Approx Size | Load Pattern | |------|---------|------------|--------------| | **icons.css** | Master icon sheet (all ~1800+ `--instui-icon-*` vars + all `.-icon-*` classes) | ~500+ KB (minified) | Docs theme loads globally; CDN usage loads selectively per icon or by category | | **icons/{name}.css** | Per-icon file (1 var + 1 class) | ~50–100 bytes each | CDN builder combines multiple into single request | | **component-icons.css** | Just the painter utility (`.instui-icon` sizing + `[class*="-icon-"]::before`) | ~1 KB | Docs always loads; used by all icon consumers | **Bundle Optimization Pattern:** - User selects icons in picker → generates CDN URLs - Links generated as `` tags or `@import` statements - jsDelivr combines multiple files: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/combine/npm/@pantoken/components/dist/icons/arrow-left.css,npm/@pantoken/components/dist/icons/check.css` - Or users load full `icons.css` and single `.-icon-*` classes --- ### **7. Icon Glyph CSS Rendering ### System Architecture (3-tier) #### Tier 1: Icon Tokens (from `@pantoken/tokens`) ```typescript // In @pantoken/tokens rebrandTokens array: { name: "--instui-icon-arrow-left", value: "url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg%3E...')", meta: { kind: "icon" } } ``` #### Tier 2: Glyph Token Classes (generated `icons.css`) File: [formats/components/src/utilities/icon-glyphs/index.ts](formats/components/src/utilities/icon-glyphs/index.ts) Generated output for each icon name: ```css .-icon-arrow-left { --pantoken-glyph: var(--instui-icon-arrow-left); } .-icon-check { --pantoken-glyph: var(--instui-icon-check); } /* etc. for all icons */ ``` #### Tier 3: Shared Painter (`.icon` utility) File: [formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css](formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css) ```css [class*="-icon-"]::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; flex: none; vertical-align: -0.125em; background: currentColor; -webkit-mask: var(--pantoken-glyph) center / contain no-repeat; mask: var(--pantoken-glyph) center / contain no-repeat; } ``` ### Rendering Flow 1. `` 2. Matches selector `[class*="-icon-"]::before` 3. Inherited `--pantoken-glyph` = `url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg...')` (via `-icon-arrow-left` rule) 4. CSS mask creates 1em box with SVG shape 5. Background fill uses `currentColor` (inherits text color) ### Why Full Bundle Files Required - `dist/component-icons.css` = lean file with only icons referenced by component CSS (e.g., close, check for Alert) - `dist/icons.css` = full sheet with all ~100+ icon glyphs - Emoticons picker needs the full sheet because it can render any icon; if only lean file loaded, unnamed icons render as filled squares --- ## 7. Test Files Overview | Test File | Coverage | |-----------|----------| | [icons.test.ts](renderers/tinymce/tests/icons.test.ts) | `loadAllIcons()`, `getIconCdnFile()`, `buildEmoticonsDatabase()`, `matchInsertedIcon()`, dedup + tie-breaking | | [icons-picker.test.ts](renderers/tinymce/tests/icons-picker.test.ts) | Plugin init, DB registration, toolbar button, ExecCommand listener, asset tracking, CodeMirror sync | | [icon-pack.test.ts](renderers/tinymce/tests/icon-pack.test.ts) | Icon alias resolution, fallback, SVG decoding | | [components-picker.test.ts](renderers/tinymce/tests/components-picker.test.ts) | Dialog open, listbox items, component insertion, CSS injection | | [logos-picker.test.ts](renderers/tinymce/tests/logos-picker.test.ts) | Dialog selectboxes, product/layout/colorMode, logo `` generation | | [content-css.test.ts](renderers/tinymce/tests/content-css.test.ts) | Asset tracking, stylesheet injection into editor content area | --- ## 8. Icon Sources & Counts ### Icon Source Metadata | Source | Import | Manifest Type | Notes | |--------|--------|----------------|-------| | **components** | `rebrandTokens` from `@pantoken/tokens` | Array of token objects | Built-in Instructure UI icons; filtered by `kind === "icon"` | | **simple-icons** | `import manifest from "@pantoken/plugin-simple-icons/manifest.json"` | JSON array of icon slugs | Brand/product icons (e.g., GitHub, Slack, AWS) | | **lucide-lab** | `import manifest from "@pantoken/plugin-lucide-lab/manifest.json"` | JSON array of icon names | Lucide Lab experimental icons | | **custom-icons** | `import { icons } from "@pantoken/plugin-custom-icons"` | Exported array of objects | Custom organizational icons; each object has `name` field | ### Icon Counts **Not hardcoded in tinymce renderer.** Counts are dynamic from the four plugin manifests at load time. To determine exact counts, run: ```typescript const icons = await loadAllIcons(); const bySource = icons.reduce((acc, i) => { acc[i.source] = (acc[i.source] ?? 0) + 1; return acc; }, {}); console.log(bySource); // { components: N, "simple-icons": M, "lucide-lab": K, "custom-icons": L } ``` --- ## 9. Emoticons Database ID & Integration ### Database Registration - **ID:** `PANTOKEN_ICONS_DATABASE_ID = "tinymce.plugins.pantoken-icons"` - **Registration:** `editor.editorManager.Resource.add(id, database)` - **TinyMCE Init Option:** Pass `emoticons_database_id: "tinymce.plugins.pantoken-icons"` to the `emoticons` plugin config - **Picker UI:** TinyMCE's native emoticons dialog auto-loads this database and displays icons categorized by the `category` field (4 tabs) ### Database Shape (Full Example) ```typescript { "components:heart": { keywords: ["heart", "Instructure UI icon: heart"], char: '', category: "Instructure UI" }, "simple-icons:github": { keywords: ["github", "Brand icon: github"], char: '', category: "Simple Icons" }, // ... 100+ more entries } ``` --- ## 10. Asset Injection Flow (Content Area CSS) When an icon is inserted, its per-icon CSS file is lazy-loaded: ``` Emoticons picker fires mceInsertContent ↓ ExecCommand listener calls trackAndInjectAsset() ↓ ───────────────────────────────────────── │ trackAndInjectAsset() does TWO things: │ ├───────────────────────────────────────── │ 1. Track in currentAssets array: │ │ currentAssets.push({ │ │ package: "@pantoken/components", │ │ path: "dist/icons/heart.css" │ │ }) │ │ onMissingAsset?.({ package, path }) │ │ │ │ 2. Inject into content document: │ │ │ │──────────────────────────────────────── ``` **Why needed:** Content-area CSS must match toolbar styling. Per-icon files are small enough to lazy-inject; full bundles would bloat every edit. --- ## 11. Source Toggle Integration (`lib/insertion-target.ts`) The TinyMCE renderer supports the `@pantoken/tinymce-codemirror` plugin's source-view toggle: ```typescript // Check if CodeMirror source mode is active getSourceTogglePlugin(editor)?.isSourceMode() // If true: // - insertHtml() → calls insertAtCursor() on CodeMirror doc // - replaceContent() → calls replaceAll() on CodeMirror doc // - insertHtmlIntoSourceViewOnly() → inserts ONLY if source mode active ``` For icons: When user is viewing HTML source, an `mceInsertContent` fires on the hidden WYSIWYG doc, but `insertHtmlIntoSourceViewOnly()` mirrors the insertion into the visible CodeMirror view. --- ## 12. File List: All Source and Plugin Files ### `/src/` (Core modules) ``` content-css.ts — CDN URL builder, runtime stylesheet injection cssdoc/ — (not detailed here — for components picker grammar validation) i18n.json — Localization base icon-pack.ts — TinyMCE toolbar icon pack (SVG data-URI, aliases) icons.ts — Main icons picker logic (TaggedIcon, emoticons DB) index.ts — Export barrel layouts.ts — Page layout templates logos.ts — Logos re-export wrapper strings.ts — UI string constants + interpolation types.ts — StarterTemplate, MissingAssetHandler lib/ insertion-target.ts — Dual-surface HTML insertion (WYSIWYG vs. CodeMirror) plugins/ components.ts — Components picker dialog content-classes.ts — Content-area class injection fullscreen-footer.ts — Fullscreen mode status footer icons.ts — Icons picker plugin (emoticons DB registration) layouts.ts — Layouts picker dialog logos.ts — Logos picker dialog pantoken.ts — Umbrella plugin (composes all pickers) searchreplace-footer.ts — Search/replace footer sup-sub.ts — Superscript/subscript button templates.ts — Templates picker dialog visualblocks-footer.ts — Visual blocks footer ``` --- This report captures the complete icons picker architecture, data flow, CSS rendering mechanism, and integration patterns across the TinyMCE renderer package.
